definitions.target_mask: row i -> token i+1 within each original piece; skip piece-last row / first-byte target

definitions.f16_target_raw: -ln(exact IEEE f16 target value); rounded row mass retained; zero targets use null total
definitions.f16_normalized: ln(sum205 exact IEEE f16 values) - ln(target value); softmax(log prior) in real arithmetic

definitions.predictor_f16_tail_floor1e6_normalized: same ratio distribution with predictor F16C bulk exact decode and scalar-tail subnormal x0.5 in columns200..204 before guard
definitions.nn_raw: original activation-probe double logsumexp of native softcapped fp32 last_logits
definitions.nn_probs: original activation-probe -ln(double(native fp32 NN softmax probability))
definitions.nn_gain_sign: prior NLL minus original NN NLL; positive is incremental NN improvement
definitions.accumulation: numpy.float64 per-row sums and NLL, math.fsum chunk and piece totals
definitions.conclusion_scope: sampled original NN target mask and input-rounded prior distributions; independent max-audit is report-only; native bit-mixer and coded package value use their measured stream scope
